name: Kahan Packaging Limited
summary: Kahan Packaging Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of polymer based woven products to business-to-business manufacturers in India. It offers polypropylene (PP) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) tapes, woven fabrics, woven sacks, and bags; and BOPP laminated PP woven bags. Kahan Packaging Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mumbai, India.
